feeds.title: Pusch & Nguyen Injury Lawyers Blog
feeds.description: Pusch and Ngyuen is a personal injury law firm specializing in all injury-related matters. Founding partner Gerard Pusch is board-certified in personal injury trial law, an accolade less than 10% of attorneys in Texas can claim. Their team of attorneys works together in all their cases to execute the most strategic legal theory to enable their clients to receive the maximum settlement possible. Their attorneys have strong knowledge and experience in handling injury claims. Their process involves keeping the client informed and educated from the start of the lawsuit until the end.

feeds.title: AZA News
feeds.description: A major portion of AZA's practice is dedicated to commercial litigation. They also represent a variety of national companies in intellectual property matters. They have special expertise in oil and gas/energy cases and intellectual property cases. AZA also manages company investigations. They help company boards, in-house counsel, and audit committees identify problems and ensure compliance before litigation ensues.

feeds.title: The Law Firm of John & Morgan, P.C. Blog
feeds.description: The Law Firm of John and Morgan, P.C., is built of a team of highly experienced lawyers. They understand how complicated the law can seem. Their goal is to explain these confusing terms into words that make sense. Open communication is key. They will always provide you with the answers you need to move forward. Their team will do everything they can to help you understand your options and find a solution. You can expect attention to detail, professionalism, and honesty every step of the way.

feeds.title: Law Office of Richard J. Presutti Blog
feeds.description: The Law Office of Richard J. Presutti, P.C., in Houston, offers aggressive representation when you have suffered injuries as the result of another's negligence. Led by founding attorney Richard J. Presutti, who has more than two decades of personal injury law experience in Texas. They are committed to helping you obtain the compensation you deserve. They handle several different personal injury claims at their firm. They represent individuals injured in motor vehicle accidents throughout the Houston metro area, as well as families who have lost loved ones in these crashes.

feeds.title: Harris County Robert W. Hainsworth Law Library
feeds.description: The Harris County Robert W. Hainsworth Law Library is a public library that serves the legal information needs of self-represented litigants, legal professionals, the judiciary, and county and other governmental officials. Its mission is to provide all of its patrons access to relevant, current, accurate, and practical legal information in the most appropriate and cost-effective formats possible and to provide educational opportunities designed to enhance patrons' understanding of legal information and how it is accessed.

feeds.title: Collier Legal Search Blog
feeds.description: At Collier Legal Search, they are committed to the highest level of service for both clients and candidates. Their placement specialists consistently seek in-depth knowledge of legal trends not just in hiring matters, but also in the law itself as the latter often directly affects headcount. Their highest goal is to match attorneys and legal staff with ideally suited law firms and company clients. Be it a law partner lateral move, a legal counsel hire, a temporary legal project, or any direct-hire scenario, smart candidate placement is the key to success for all parties involved.

feeds.title: McCulloch & Miller Blog
feeds.description: At the Houston law firm of McCulloch and Miller, PLLC, they provide comprehensive estate planning. Over the past 40 years, they've learned the greatest key to effective estate planning involves listening attentively to their client's diverse needs and goals. They strive to foster long-term relationships with their clients by working with them to identify all of their objectives and collaboratively working together to develop a list of effective strategies. Their goal is to make sure your estate plan agrees with your goals, your family dynamics, and protects your retirement assets.

feeds.title: Daughtry & Farine, P.C. Blog
feeds.description: With over 80 years of combined legal experience, Daughtry and Farine attorneys utilize a winning combination of legal expertise and tactical knowledge to meet the needs of their clients. Their attorneys have broad and in-depth knowledge of property owners' association law. They emphasize a team approach in their law practice and always strive to have an attorney available to answer their clients' questions. Their lawyers and staff work hard to help their clients succeed.

feeds.title: The Sparrow Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: The Sparrow Law Firm, PLLC brings a strong and fearless attitude to their clients' aid. They are committed to providing diligent and comprehensive legal representation so you will always have somebody by your side throughout the legal process. Their firm focuses on providing both bankruptcy and family law legal services, and they understand the great stress that both of these practice areas can take on the average person. They're proud that their law firm offers top-notch legal services with affordable pricing.

feeds.title: Juan L. Guerra Jr. & Associates Blog
feeds.description: Based in Houston, Juan L. Guerra Jr. and Associates works with clients across the country to challenge criminal allegations. Their primary attorney, Juan L. Guerra Jr., has practiced criminal law for over 15 years. He has extensive experience across the spectrum of criminal charges, including serious murder and drug crime cases. Their mission is to resolve your case as efficiently as possible while achieving optimal results.

feeds.title: Patterson, PC Blog

Business litigation is often extremely complex, and they help their clients understand their options for resolving disputes in the most cost-efficient, forward-thinking manner possible. Their Houston business litigation lawyers can work closely with you to find customized solutions that protect your interests.

Their team of experienced attorneys is here to help you get your life and business back up and running.

feeds.title: Anti-Corruption & Compliance Blog
feeds.description: Check out the latest updates to the Anti-Corruption and Compliance Blog. feeds.title: Texas Construction Law Blog
feeds.description: Porter Hedges attorneys represent owners, contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, sureties, design professionals, construction managers, and lenders in resolving complex construction issues. Check out the latest updates to the Texas Construction Law Blog here.

feeds.title: The Law Office of Greg Tsioros Blog
feeds.description: Houston criminal defense attorney Greg Tsioros provides legal counsel and protects the rights of clients who are accused of committing misdemeanors and state or federal-level felonies. He defends his clients in an array of criminal cases from identity theft and indecent exposure to more severe DWI and drug charges. He also provides skilled representation for parole issues. If you are applying for parole or fighting a parole revocation, The Law Office of Greg Tsioros can help. Mr. Tsioros has years of experience as a Texas state prosecutor and as an accomplished criminal defense lawyer.

feeds.title: John T. Floyd Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: John T. Floyd is Board Certified in Criminal Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. He is respected nationally as one of the leading state and federal criminal law authorities. The criminal defense attorneys at their firm take nothing for granted. Mr. Floyd and his experienced team of professionals investigate every possible detail and thoroughly research and analyze the facts and law surrounding the case to develop a specific defense strategy.

feeds.title: The Hill Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: The team at The Hill Law Firm is more than experienced criminal defense attorneys. They are skilled fighters with superior legal abilities. Their team has a thorough understanding of the law, extensive experience in criminal defense, and the skills needed to provide the best defense possible for their clients. Using their knowledge and experience, they prepare the strongest defense for their clients. They conduct in-depth examinations of all the evidence prosecutors intend to present during your trial and speak with all subpoenaed witnesses who will testify in court.

feeds.title: Stephenson Fournier Blog
feeds.description: A combination of business sense, common sense, and sophisticated legal knowledge makes Stephenson Fournier the clear choice for clients who want a law firm they can count on. They provide sound legal solutions tailored to meet each individual's specific needs. Their skilled attorneys can assist with business law, commercial transactions, real estate, estate planning, and probate matters. They are committed to providing high-quality service, tempered by a sensitivity to each client's business concerns and budget.

feeds.title: Bayley Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: The Houston family attorneys at the Bayley Law Firm understand the difficulties their clients are facing when they retain them. They consider it a privilege to have the opportunity to help guide their clients through the challenges of litigation. That's why they make it their mission to make the litigation process as painless as possible. They accomplish that goal by providing honest legal counsel, prompt and regular communication, reasonable rates, and aggressive representation in court.

feeds.title: Houston DWI Law Blog
feeds.description: The Houston DWI Law Blog, curated by legal experts, serves as an invaluable resource for individuals navigating the complexities of DWI cases. Whether one seeks guidance on defense strategies or stays abreast of the latest legal developments, the Houston DWI Law Blog is an indispensable tool for anyone confronting DWI challenges.

feeds.title: Mingledorff Law Blog

With more than 60 years of combined legal experience, their lawyers can provide you with an aggressive criminal defense. They will stand up for you against criminal charges whether rape, murder, federal drug charges, or theft.

feeds.title: Murray-Lobb Blog

They enjoy long-term relationships with their clients - business owners, general contractors, real estate investors, financial institutions, and individuals and they work closely with their clients in every phase to help manage risk and achieve goals.

feeds.title: Tritico Rainey Blog
feeds.description: At Tritico Rainey, they represent individuals and organizations facing a variety of legal challenges. As dedicated trial attorneys, they seek to use their significant courtroom experience to guide clients through the legal process to a successful outcome.

feeds.title: Henke & Williams, LLP Blog

feeds.title: The Antu Law Firm, PLLC Blog

In her over 18 years of legal experience, she's been on all sides of the playing field. As a former chief prosecutor, she understands exactly what you are up against, and as a former criminal judge, she knows what type of defense you need to reduce or eliminate serious charges in Texas.

feeds.title: The Law Office of Daniel D. Horowitz, III PC Blog

Their firm offers aggressive advocacy for personal injury victims in a wide range of cases. They help you understand your legal options and build a strong compensation case.

feeds.title: The Moster Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: The Moster Law Firm is a nationally recognized AV Preeminent Law Firm with five offices in Texas. They also represent emerging businesses - small and large - in all areas from startups, business law, litigation, technology, intellectual property, patents, oil and gas, employment, and other matters. They are known for their creativity, client responsiveness, and aggressive approach to the law.

feeds.title: Amaro Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: The Amaro Law Firm is a Houston, Texas-based law firm that aggressively represents parties in personal injury, 18-wheeler wreck, and work injury cases. feeds.title: Houston Immigration Legal Services Collaborative Blog

feeds.title: Neal Davis Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: At Neal Davis Law Firm, they hold themselves to the highest standard of success: ensuring that you get the best outcome possible for your case. They'll undertake your case with the greatest of care and personal attention, working diligently to protect your freedom and reputation. Where possible, they seek dismissal, often by giving the prosecutor no other choice.

feeds.title: Mayday Law Office Blog

Their legal team fights to get clients the maximum compensation they deserve. They stand up to unjust insurance companies and liable parties, working endlessly to get a fair recovery for injured Houstonians.

feeds.title: The Fealy Law Firm Blog
